Type: Chesterfield upholstered ottoman
Use: footrest, extra seating; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, button tufting, loose cushion, dark turned wood feet
Colors: light cool grey, dark brown
Shape: rectangular, plump cushion top, button-tufted sides, short turned bun feet, low and solid
Feel: classic, comfortable, refined
Goes with: dark wood, white and navy tones, Chesterfield sofas; traditional living rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Bradbury Chesterfield Classic Ottoman, 30"W, Slate (Renewed)
product.description: This lovely ottoman has the low profile and short legs that are the hallmark of the classic chesterfield style. Whether as a statement piece or part of a living-room suite, this ottoman will be a welcome addition to any decor. 30"W x 22"D x 20"H Solid hardwood frame; upholstery: 98% polyester, 2% nylon This ottoman doubles as a welcome place to rest tired feet or as extra seating. A classic style updated in stain-resistant fabric makes this perfect for the modern home. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
